card.title: PS5 3-Beep / No Power Southbridge CXD90061 and BIOS W25Q16JVSNIM Diagnostics

claims.statement: If the PS5 beeps 3 times when pressing power but does not turn on and all voltages are normal, suspect BIOS firmware corruption.
claims.evidence: Source notes 3 beeps with all voltages present indicates BIOS corruption.
claims.quote: When console beep 3 times but not powers on check all voltages if all ok it could be a BIOS corruption.

claims.statement: Flux under the Southbridge BGA can disrupt the 25MHz and 32kHz crystal oscillator clock signals.
claims.evidence: Source specifically highlights BGA flux causing oscillator issues.
claims.quote: Flux under BGA can cause oscillator problems.

claims.statement: If BIOS communication is present on the DI pin but absent on the DO pin, the BIOS firmware or IC is likely faulty.
claims.evidence: Oscilloscope testing shows data entering on DI but no response returning on DO.
claims.quote: If communication is present at the DI pin but there is no communication going out at pin DO then firmware / IC could be faulty.

claims.statement: A standby current draw stuck at 7mA requires checking PMIC voltages, Southbridge clock signals, and BIOS communication.
claims.evidence: Source outlines sequence of clock and communication checks when stuck at 7mA standby current.
claims.quote: When console get’s standby power if it is stuck at 7mA. Check the voltages of Dialog ic and frequency of the 25Mhz clock and the 32Khz clock of the Southbridge IC.

claims.statement: Pressing the power button requires the +1.1V Southbridge power rail to be generated for operation.
claims.evidence: Source states +1.1V must be generated for Southbridge on power press.
claims.quote: If you press power button the power rail +1.1V must be generated for the Southbridge IC.

procedure: Verify standby power rails including +3.3V STBY and confirm +1.1V rail is generated for Southbridge upon pressing power button.
Use an oscilloscope to verify 25MHz and 32kHz clock frequencies at the crystal oscillators near Southbridge.
Measure BIOS IC (W25Q16JVSNIM) supply voltage and probe clock pins with an oscilloscope.
Monitor BIOS data line activity on pin DI and verify output communication on pin DO.
If DI pin shows activity but DO pin shows none, reflash firmware or replace the BIOS IC and Southbridge IC.

measurements.context: Southbridge RTC clock signal in standby
Generated for Southbridge when power button pressed

cautions: Ensure no flux residue remains beneath BGA components as trapped flux can disrupt oscillator signals.
card.caveats: Always measure all voltage rails before concluding BIOS firmware corruption when diagnosing 3-beep power issues.
